modules.module_title: Maintain safe and secure working environment

pcs.pc_description: identify hazardous activities and the possible causes of risks or accidents in the workplace
implement safe working practices for dealing with hazards to ensure safety of self and others
conduct regular checks of the machines with support of the maintenance team to identify potential hazards
ensure that all the tools/equipment/fasteners/spare parts are arranged as per specifications/utility into proper trays, cabinets, lockers as mentioned in the 5S guidelines/work instructions
organise safety drills or training sessions to create awareness amongst others on the identified risks and safety practices
fill daily check sheet to report improvements done and risks identified
ensure that relevant safety boards/signs are placed on the shop floor for the safety of self and others
report any identified breaches in health, safety and security policies and procedures to the designated person
ensure workplace, equipment, restrooms etc. are sanitized regularly
ensure team is aware about hygiene and sanitation regulations and following them on the shop floor
ensure availability of running water, hand wash and alcohol-based sanitizers at the workplace
report advanced hygiene and sanitation issues to appropriate authority
follow stress and anxiety management techniques and support employees to cope with stress, anxiety etc
wear and dispose PPEs regularly and appropriately
ensure recyclable, non-recyclable and hazardous wastes are segregated as per SOP
ensure proper mechanism is followed while collecting and disposing of non-recyclable, recyclable and reusable waste
ensure malfunctioning (fumes/sparks/emission/vibration/noise) and lapse in maintenance of equipment are resolved effectively
prepare and analyze material and energy audit reports to decipher excessive consumption of material and water
identify possibilities of using renewable energy and environment friendly fuels
identify processes where material and energy/electricity utilization can be optimized

modules.module_title: Conduct training of team on welding preparatory activities

pcs.pc_description: brief the learners about workplace health and safety requirements and the consequences of not adhering to the same

explain learners about how to read and interpret welding drawing, Welding Procedure Specification (WPS), job orders, SOPs, manual to get information about type of welding need to perform, tools, equipment and input material required and output product specifications and requirements
explain and demonstrate each step of checking of the tools, equipment and input material for defects and required quality standards
clarify all technical aspects and performance parameters of the different types of welding
show learners how to select and prepare raw material and electrodes as per the selected welding method
demonstrate each step of setting the welding machine and its parameters as per the selected welding method
demonstrate each step of installing the work pieces and fixture on the apparatus and aligning them with the electrodes as per the job requirements
ensure that all learners can see the demonstration and hear the instructions and explanations clearly
provide opportunity to each learner for practicing each step in the task or procedure required to be learned immediately after the demonstration
guide participant to demonstrate the welding work preparatory activities during the sessions

modules.module_title: Conduct training of team on welding activities

pcs.pc_description: explain the various welding methods, their process flow and do's/don’ts of the manufacturing process
conduct training sessions on various welding methods i.e. spot, seam, MIG, TIG and robotic welding for producing the components as per the drawing, SOP and WI
demonstrate correct angle of holding torch and filler wire, the direction of weld and feed and travel speed during the welding operation
demonstrate each step of producing joints of the specified dimensional accuracy and required weld quality
explain and demonstrate each step of measuring the welded component and comparing it with the dimensions and specifications prescribed in the WPS and engineering drawing
demonstrate how to observe the malfunctions/defects in the machine during operations and monitor the process parameters by reading gauges

provide opportunity and guide each participant to demonstrate the welding process as per the selected welding method and producing components as per the dimensions and specifications given in the WPS and drawing

modules.module_title: Conduct training of team on post-welding activities

pcs.pc_description: conduct training session on post welding activities such as quality inspection of welded components, segregation and storage of final components, machine maintenance and preparation of records and documents as per organisational guidelines
elaborate various welding defects and their impact on the welded component
explain and demonstrate each step of quality check tests and repairing of defects from the components
demonstrate the procedure of segregating, tagging and storing the final components followed in an organisation
explain and demonstrate each step of tools and machine maintenance activities after completion of work
describe various documents and records related to welding work, maintenance work etc. need to update and maintain after completion of work
address the queries and doubts of the participants
provide appropriate feedback to the participants
store and maintain relevant records related to training
monitor the cleanliness and tidiness of the workshop area
secure equipment and tools in safe places in accordance with procedures
Use welding simulators to practice weld paths and evaluate accuracy of technique.
Write basic robotic welding program for automated welding setup using sample workpieces.
Analyze weld quality using real-time sensor feedback and modify parameters accordingly.
Retrieve and interpret process logs from smart welding machines or cloud platforms.
Conduct a sustainability assessment to monitor material wastage and energy use during welding.
